Name: farm-plot-selector
Commands:
turn off "EC Test Farm" farmplot
turn on "EC Test Farm" farmplot
if "EC Test Farm" farmplot is on
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: farm selector"

Name: seed-alias-transfer
Commands:
transfer 2 "fruit seeds" from "source cargo" to "destination cargo"
assign sourceCount to "source cargo" amount "fruit seeds"
assign destinationCount to "destination cargo" amount "fruit seeds"
if sourceCount is 3 and destinationCount is 2
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: seed transfer counts"

Name: empty-farm-crop-state
Commands:
assign ecOccupiedFlag to "EC Test Farm" farmplot occupied
assign ecLivingFlag to "EC Test Farm" farmplot crop alive
assign ecCropName to "EC Test Farm" farmplot crop
if ecOccupiedFlag or ecLivingFlag or ecCropName != ""
  print "EC_FAIL: fresh farm must be empty"
else
  print "EC_PASS"

Name: food-recipe-blueprint
Commands:
tell "EC Test Kitchen" foodprocessor to create "kelp crisp"
assign ecRecipeQueued to "EC Test Kitchen" foodprocessor producing "kelp crisp"
if ecRecipeQueued
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: kelp crisp blueprint was not queued"

Name: farm-water-units
Commands:
assign ecWaterRatio to "EC Test Farm" farm plot percentage
assign ecWaterLevel to "EC Test Farm" farm plot level
assign ecWaterCapacity to "EC Test Farm" farm plot capacity
print ecWaterRatio
print ecWaterLevel
print ecWaterCapacity
set "EC Test Farm" farm plot level to 999
if ecWaterRatio is 0.25 and ecWaterLevel is 45 and ecWaterCapacity is 180 and "EC Test Farm" farm plot level is 45
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: water units or read-only setter"

Name: oxygen-farm-ratio
Commands:
turn on "EC Test Oxygen" oxygen farm
turn on "EC Test Half Oxygen" oxygen farm
wait 3
assign ecOxygenRatio to "EC Test Oxygen" oxygen farm percentage
assign ecHalfRatio to "EC Test Half Oxygen" oxygen farm ratio
print ecOxygenRatio
print ecHalfRatio
if ecOxygenRatio <= 0 or ecOxygenRatio > 1 or ecHalfRatio <= 0 or ecHalfRatio > 1
  print "EC_FAIL: sunlight factor must be a nonzero fraction"
else
  turn off "EC Test Oxygen" oxygen farm
  wait 2
  if "EC Test Oxygen" oxygen farm percentage is 0
    print "EC_PASS"
  else
    print "EC_FAIL: unpowered oxygen output"

Name: crop-input-output
Commands:
print "EC Test Farm" farm plot crop
print "EC Test Farm" farm plot crop input
print "EC Test Farm" farm plot crop output
if "EC Test Farm" farm plot occupied and "EC Test Farm" farm plot crop alive and "EC Test Farm" farm plot crop input is 1 and "EC Test Farm" farm plot crop output >= 0
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: newly planted crop amounts"

Name: algae-countdown-units
Commands:
assign ecSecondsBefore to "EC Test Algae" algae farm countdown
assign ecRate to "EC Test Algae" algae farm output
wait 3
assign ecSecondsAfter to "EC Test Algae" algae farm countdown
print ecRate
print ecSecondsBefore
print ecSecondsAfter
assign ecElapsedSeconds to ecSecondsBefore - ecSecondsAfter
if ecRate > 0 and ecRate <= 0.334 and ecSecondsBefore > 0 and ecElapsedSeconds > 1 and ecElapsedSeconds < 8
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: algae production countdown"

Name: algae-blocked-countdown
Commands:
wait 3
print "EC Test Half Algae" algae farm output
print "EC Test Half Algae" algae farm countdown
if "EC Test Half Algae" algae farm output is 0 and "EC Test Half Algae" algae farm countdown is -1
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: unavailable algae countdown"

Name: crop-mature-and-dead
Commands:
assign ecYield to "EC Test Mature Farm" farm plot crop output
assign ecDeadYield to "EC Test Dead Farm" farm plot crop output
assign ecMature to "EC Test Mature Farm" farm plot crop complete
assign ecDead to "EC Test Dead Farm" farm plot crop dead
print ecYield
print ecDeadYield
if ecYield is 2 and ecDeadYield is 2 and ecMature and ecDead
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: restored crop states"

Name: food-production
Commands:
tell "EC Test Kitchen" food processor to create 5 "kelp crisp"
turn on "EC Test Kitchen" food processor
wait 5
assign ecCooking to "EC Test Kitchen" food processor is running
assign ecProgress to "EC Test Kitchen" food processor progress
print ecCooking
print ecProgress
if ecCooking and ecProgress >= 0 and ecProgress <= 1
  turn off "EC Test Kitchen" food processor
  wait 5
  if "EC Test Kitchen" assembler is running
    print "EC_FAIL: disabled production"
  else
    assign ecMealsBefore to "EC Test Kitchen" inventories[1] amount "kelp crisp"
    turn on "EC Test Kitchen" assembler
    wait 12
    if "EC Test Kitchen" inventories[1] amount "kelp crisp" > ecMealsBefore
      print "EC_PASS"
    else
      print "EC_FAIL: no cooked item"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: production status or progress"
